saw_lines: Women buy bras by fit, then rebuy the same size for years, so one good fit decides the reorder.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a shopper decides whether their fit question gets answered at all.
Your site shows 500+ members already inside, yet 0 of 27 ads carry that number. Put it on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 500+ members already inside, yet 0 of 27 ads carry that number, so a new buyer gets no proof before the click. Put the count on every creative, then open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 60% off on limited products, but only 2 of 26 ads mention percent off, so a first buyer sees no reason to act. Put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
Your site explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 27 ads answer that, so a buyer unsure about delivery has no reason to click. Show the box arriving in one video ad, opening on the parcel at the door.

8 of 26 ads are creator posts with codes, #ad tags or @mentions, run from your brand page, so the recommendation reads as a brand ad. Whitelist those posts from the creator accounts and cut three variations of the best one.

ads_1: Fit led video, with the member count and 60% offer in line one
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, X and Youtube
